getToKnow.heading: Getting to know us
getToKnow.body: Nobody has to do the optional ones before proposing for a role.

items.title: Attend Community Call
items.description: Learn about the basics and ask any immediate questions about {village}.

items.title: Participate in Events
items.description: Join potlucks, events, workshops, and parties on our land to experience the community.

items.title: Village Weaving Immersion
items.description: Spend immersive time in the village learning how it operates, observing circles in action, and discovering where your gifts are most needed. A beautiful step, but not required. It is also how you join the Founding Seeders.

items.title: Community Training
items.description: Either complete our training in NVC (Nonviolent Communication), authentic relating, and other community practices, or demonstrate you already know and live these essential practices.

hero.headline: Join the village
hero.intro: Roles are how the work of {village} gets done, and each one is held by a person. Start with the roles, pick what calls you and propose yourself. We walk with you from there.

rights.heading: Your rights and responsibilities
rights.body: Read what we ask of you, what you can count on from us, and how leaving a role works.

steps.heading: How joining a role works
steps.intro: Eleven steps. Some are your moves and some are the circle's, and each one tells you which.

items.title: Start at the roles
items.description: Look through the open roles. Each role card says what the role does and the commitment it asks.

items.title: Pick the roles that call you
items.description: Choose one role or several, and see how they fit together in a season.

items.title: Propose yourself
items.description: Tell us about you and what you would bring to the season. We ask for three references, or a background check in their place. We contact references only after our first conversation, and only with your OK.

items.title: Align with the {commitment}
items.description: Read the {commitment} and tell us whether it feels right for you. If something does not sit well, say so.

items.title: Confirm your email
items.description: We send you a link. Open it to confirm that the proposal is yours, and it goes on to the circle.

items.title: Meet the stewards, one at a time
items.description: The stewards of the role each meet you for a conversation. You can ask them anything too.

items.title: The circle decides by consent
items.description: The circle weighs your proposal together. People choose people, and we tell you what the circle decided.

items.title: Accept the invitation
items.description: If the circle says yes, we send you an invitation to the role. It is yours to accept.

items.title: Align with the confidentiality agreement
items.description: Some of what a role holds belongs to other people. You read the agreement and say you can keep it.

items.title: Your first 14 days
items.description: You begin the role and settle in with the circle that holds it.

items.title: Join the moon rhythm
items.description: From here the role runs moon to moon. You plan with your circle, deliver, and look back together.
